_readme: Card behaviors for the play engine. Keys match the ids in deck.json. Filters are checked against the official card data in cards.json (hero, elemental, vision, destiny, monster, spell, trap, fusion, normal, effect, levelMin, levelMax, attr, race, name, nameHas, materialHas, notSelf). 'do' is add, send, place, summon, mark, destroyOwn, or fusion. 'from' is deck, extra, gy, hand, field, or ban. 'short' is the label in the once-per-turn list. 'trackOnly' effects (like on-attack destroys) are tracked and can be marked stopped but don't show up as plays. Locks: 'allow' is the filter for what you can still Special Summon while the lock is on; 'extraOnly' means it only limits summons from the Extra Deck. 'priority' is 'protect' (your choke points) or 'bait' (fine to lose; play it first to draw out a negate); 'baitIfHand' makes it bait only while that card is in your hand.

onSummon.label: Stratos: add a HERO monster or destroy Spells/Traps
onSummon.stopTip: If you hold Faris and a HERO to discard, the engine still runs. Otherwise set up for next turn.

onSentToGY.label: Shadow Mist (sent to GY): add a HERO, not Shadow Mist
onSentToGY.stopTip: No Shadow Mist search this turn. Use Vyon's dump on Neos to stage Favorite Contact.

summonProc.label: Faris (discard a HERO)
summonProc.stopTip: Faris didn't land. Use your Normal Summon on Stratos or Vyon instead.

onSummon.label: Faris: place a Vision HERO in your backrow
onSummon.stopTip: No Increase placed. Normal Summon Vyon if you have it, or switch to Fusion Destiny.

onSummon.label: Vyon: send a HERO from your Deck to the GY
onSummon.stopTip: No dump. Stage Neos another way (Shadow Mist's search or E-Call) before you rely on Favorite Contact.

ignition.label: Vyon: banish a HERO from GY, add Polymerization
ignition.stopTip: No Polymerization search. Use Instant Contact or Fusion Destiny if you have them, or hold what's on board.

onSummon.label: Increase: Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Vision HERO from your Deck
onSummon.stopTip: No Vyon this turn. Normal Summon what you can, get Malicious bodies out, and save Polymerization for next turn.

inGY.label: Increase: back to backrow (you took damage)

gyEffect.label: Malicious: banish from GY, summon one from Deck
gyEffect.stopTip: The Malicious stays banished. You can still use the other copies later.

spell.label: A Hero Lives
spell.stopTip: The LP is paid, but your Normal Summon is still open.

spell.label: Fusion Destiny
spell.stopTip: No Fusion Destiny monster. Build the Elemental line instead: Sunrise into Infernal Rage.

spell.label: Instant Contact (1000 LP)
spell.stopTip: Instant Contact is spent for the turn. Fall back to Polymerization or Miracle Fusion.

trap.label: Favorite Contact
trap.stopTip: Favorite Contact is gone. Keep DPE or Dangerous up to interrupt instead.

ignition.label: DPE: destroy 1 of yours + 1 card
ignition.stopTip: DPE's Quick Effect is spent. If it gets destroyed, it still brings back a Destiny HERO next Standby Phase.

onSummon.label: Shining Neos Wingman: destroy their cards
onSummon.stopTip: Shining Neos Wingman is still a 3100+ body that can't be destroyed by effects. Swing with it.

onSummon.label: Infernal Rage: add a “Favorite” card
onSummon.stopTip: No Favorite Contact. Keep Infernal Rage as a Wingman for Polymerization into Shining Neos Wingman next turn.

ignition.label: Infernal Rage: tribute it, summon an Elemental HERO

onSummon.label: Sunrise: add Miracle Fusion
onSummon.stopTip: No Miracle Fusion. Polymerization or Instant Contact can still reach a Wingman.

ignition.label: Dangerous: discard 1, send a Destiny HERO to the GY

onSummon.label: Dystopia: burn for a Level 4 or lower Destiny HERO in your GY

ignition.label: Dystopia: destroy a card (its ATK changed)

onSummon.label: Cross Crusader: revive a Destiny HERO

ignition.label: Cross Crusader: tribute a Destiny HERO, add a HERO
Wonder Driver: Set a Polymerization or Fusion spell from GY
ignition.short: Wonder Driver: Set a Fusion spell

onSummon.label: Infernal Devicer: add Neos (reveal Shining Neos Wingman)
